thread:
lisa: :rotating_light: noticing a spike in inference quality alerts from the EU canary. multiple customers reporting hallucinations and some 5xxs. rollout id=rl-2026-03-15-88, model=redwood-open-7b-q4f, quant_flag=true. can anyone grab this?

oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Canary Quality Regression detected for rollout rl-2026-03-15-88. Metric: hallucination_rate increased 6.2x, error_5xx increased 3.8x. Affected region: eu-west. Pager -> eng-oncall.

maria: on it. starting triage. can you point me to the canary hosts/cluster?

lisa: canary pool is dedicated-eu-west-pool-7. I see a stream of eval failures in s3://redwood-eval/2026/03/15/rl-88/*. Also logs in runtime-gpu-7.

maria: pulling logs. initial guess: quant kernel mismatch triggered by last-night kernel update? looking at /var/log/runtime/kernel-load.log now.

devin: I can try to flip the feature flag to kill the rollout if needed. Which flag name?

lisa: flag: ff.rollout.rl-2026-03-15-88.enable. If we kill it we should route traffic back to stable variant redwood-open-7b-q4a.

samir: adding: some customers see outputs with repeated nonsense tokens and high perplexity. Customer support has 3 P1s open.

maria: confirmed kernel mismatch warnings in the logs: "kv_cache_incompatible: expected dtype int8, got int4" — that explains the quality drop. looks like the runtime selected a q4f path but model uploaded as q4a.

lisa: that's bad. maria, do you want me to flip the flag or you?

maria: I'll do it. running kill switch now. command: ```
# kill rollout
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://controlplane.internal/api/rollouts/rl-2026-03-15-88/disable
```

maria: sent. controlplane responded 200. traffic steering initiating failover to stable. watching metrics.

oncall-bot: ROLLOUT DISABLED — rl-2026-03-15-88 disabled by maria. Automated routing rollback started.

devin: confirming traffic shift: canary traffic decreased to 0% in 45s. current active variant: redwood-open-7b-q4a.

lisa: CPU/GPU error 5xxs dropping back to baseline. hallucination alerts decreasing. support notified that mitigation is in progress.

samir: customer-impact note: 3 enterprise customers saw >20% bad responses over the 12m window. CS is drafting temporary communications.

maria: reopening CI to run evals on q4f vs q4a mapping and checking why kernel selector chose q4f. will also roll forward a patch to the kernel selection guard.

lisa: ack. we should run a postmortem and include checklist: safer kernel selection, server-side validation of model artifact metadata, and automated preflight evals for canary.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT STATUS — Mitigated. Time to mitigation: ~3m 40s from first alert. Incident owner: maria. Next: postmortem in #incidents, tag eng-runtime and eng-ml.

devin: handing off to maria for post-incident followup. If anything regresses ping me.

maria: taking postmortem. will capture timeline, root cause, and remediation plan (hotfix + tests). ETA for postmortem draft: EOD 2026-03-16.

lisa: thanks team. closing thread after postmortem link. :thumbsup:
